cases.input: From Walmart's consolidated statement of income, by what percentage did consolidated net income attributable to Walmart change from the fiscal year ended January 31, 2018 to the fiscal year ended January 31, 2019, to one decimal place (amounts in millions of dollars), and what line item largely explains it?
cases.expected: It fell about 32.4% (from $9,862 million to $6,670 million, a decrease of $3,192 million), largely reflecting $8,368 million of other (gains) and losses recorded in fiscal 2019.
